instruction:
# 联系偏好表单的错误恢复设计

## 任务

你是负责公共服务设计交接的设计师。基于离线官方设计系统和无障碍标准，为一个明确标注为示例的公共服务制作可交接的原创设计方案。不得将示例文案描述成真实政府服务要求。

## 输入材料

输入目录 `/app/input_files/` 只读。请使用随包附件，不依赖联网检索。

- `/app/input_files/design_reference.html`：官方设计系统页面原始离线HTML；以页面正文为准。
- `/app/input_files/wcag22.html`：W3C WCAG 2.2 2024-12-12规范离线全文。
- `/app/input_files/NOTICE.txt`：原始来源、许可边界与独立派生设计声明。
- `/app/input_files/commission.docx`：本管线编写的明确设计委托及样例文案，不是外部真实业务数据。

## 工作要求

- [Q01] Persistent label: Email address is a visible label; placeholder is not a label.
- [Q02] Required indicator: Email address (required) is the exact required field label.
- [Q03] Example guidance: Example: name@example.com appears before the field.
- [Q04] Invalid entry: The error specimen retains the typed value name@.
- [Q05] Corrective error: Enter an email address in the format name@example.com.
- [Q06] Non-color error: The invalid field has a text error and an error icon, not red alone.
- [Q07] Keyboard focus: The focused field has a 3 px outline with 2 px offset.
- [Q08] Optional field: Phone number (optional) remains optional and is not an error.
- [Q09] Primary action: Save preferences is the primary button; Cancel is secondary.
- [Q10] Error focus: On submit, focus moves to the error summary before the invalid field.
- [Q11] Input semantics: Use type=email, autocomplete=email and aria-describedby for hint/error.
- [Q12] Responsive layout: Show desktop 960 px and narrow 320 px states with no horizontal scroll.
- [Q13] 交付文件名: 交付恰好列明的三个文件，文件名与交付清单逐字相同。
- [Q14] 视觉稿页数: PDF至少两页，并包含主方案和状态/实施说明；印刷题必须包含所要求的印刷第二页。
- [Q15] 可编辑交接: PDF中的核心视觉及关键状态在PPTX均有对应的原生可编辑形状和文字，不得整页贴图或只交付要求清单冒充可编辑母版。
- [Q16] 字号下限: 可编辑正文不小于10 pt、脚注不小于9 pt；印刷方案正文遵从各题专门字号。
- [Q17] 实施边界: handoff.docx明确静态设计不是已上线且已测的实现，列出后续键盘/读屏验证。
- [Q18] 视觉层次: 在视觉PDF用不同字号清楚区分标题与正文，并使用主色/表面色区分信息区块。
- [Q19] 只读保护: 保持源文件内容的SHA256不变。
- [Q20] 文字完整性: PDF和PPTX不得遮挡、重叠或裁切正文。
- [Q21] 文件可打开: 三个文件均未加密且能被对应的PDF/Office解析器打开。
- [Q22] 事实安全: 全部交付文件均不得捏造输入没有提供的实测可用性提升百分比。

## 交付文件

- `/app/output/DE-P100-001_design.pdf`：主视觉与状态/印刷方案PDF
- `/app/output/DE-P100-001_editable.pptx`：可编辑版式/交接PPTX
- `/app/output/DE-P100-001_handoff.docx`：实施标注、依据和风险边界DOCX

## 硬约束

仅将交付物写入 `/app/output/`，文件名须与要求完全一致；不得修改输入。引用随包材料并保留可复核的来源定位；不得将出题假设写成真实业务事实。

gold.text:
Contact preferences — handoff

Version

1.0 — Initial issue. Authored reference candidate; not expert-approved or judge-accepted.

Source boundary

USWDS and W3C are frozen offline references. Specimens are original examples; no real service claim is made.

Persistent label

Email address is a visible label; placeholder is not a label.

Required indicator

Email address (required) is the exact required field label.

Example guidance

Example: name@example.com appears before the field.

Invalid entry

The error specimen retains the typed value name@.

Corrective error

Enter an email address in the format name@example.com.

Non-color error

The invalid field has a text error and an error icon, not red alone.

Keyboard focus

The focused field has a 3 px outline with 2 px offset.

Optional field

Phone number (optional) remains optional and is not an error.

Primary action

Save preferences is the primary button; Cancel is secondary.

Error focus

On submit, focus moves to the error summary before the invalid field.

Input semantics

Use type=email, autocomplete=email and aria-describedby for hint/error.

Responsive layout

Show desktop 960 px and narrow 320 px states with no horizontal scroll.

Implementation IDs and focus path

email-hint -> email-input -> email-error. On invalid Save preferences: focus error-summary (tabindex=-1), activate its email link -> email-input, Tab -> optional phone-input -> Save preferences -> Cancel. Focus ring 3 px/2 px is a commission token, not a WCAG-mandated pixel value.

Acceptance test

Enter name@, submit, verify retained name@ and linked error summary; replace with name@example.com, resubmit, verify error removal without claiming a saved server state. Test 320 CSS px reflow and keyboard-only order.

Normative traceability

WCAG 2.2: SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships for labels/headings; SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum); SC 1.4.10 Reflow; SC 2.4.3 Focus Order; SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible; SC 3.3.1 Error Identification and SC 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions where inputs exist; SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value for controls. These are applicability anchors, not a declaration that all criteria were tested.

Visual specification

Use navy #102A43, teal #006D77, ink #172B4D, pale surface #EAF0F4 and white. Editable body text at least 10 pt; footnotes may use 9 pt. Print body obeys the commission-specific minimum. Avoid overlapping/clipped text. PDF contains at least two pages. Editable PPTX text must remain selectable.

Verification boundary

Static design is not implementation conformance. Browser/keyboard/screen reader behavior must be validated after implementation; no measured usability gains are claimed.

Source and permission notice

Independent original example commission, not endorsed by USWDS or W3C.
USWDS reference: https://designsystem.digital.gov/components/text-input/
USWDS main project CC0; third-party exceptions remain subject to their notices. See https://designsystem.digital.gov/documentation/code-guidelines/
W3C source: https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/REC-WCAG22-20241212/
W3C copyright and license notices remain in the unmodified offline source. Derived design annotations are independent additions, not an altered W3C specification. W3C Document License: https://www.w3.org/copyright/document-license/
